title: Figures 71-72: CFD pressure and temperature around Tic Tac UAP at 300 mph subsonic
description: Two CFD contour plots of the Tic Tac UAP model at 1/6 scale, air temperature 223K and 300 mph with subsonic inlet and subsonic outlet. Figure 71 shows the pressure field in Pascals; Figure 72 shows the temperature field in Kelvin with a warm wake behind the capsule body. Low-speed case in the BAASS Tic Tac aerodynamic speed sweep.
